title: spect_scaled
description: `spect_scaled` analyzes an audio signal and outputs spectral data, including dB-scaled magnitudes and a list of constant-Q power bins. In `spect_scaled 4096 4 log 80 12000 80`, it uses a 4096-point FFT with fourfold overlap to produce 80 logarithmically spaced constant-Q bands from 80 Hz to 12 kHz.
